dataset: Small molecule retention by Gram-negative bacteria (LC/MS screen)

paper.title: Measurement and prediction of small molecule retention by Gram-negative bacteria based on a large-scale LC/MS screen

license.name: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0
license.verified_from: article page, Rights and permissions section
restrictions: NonCommercial: commercial use is outside this licence.
NoDerivatives: the licence does not permit sharing adapted material derived from the article or parts of it.
Data availability statement names no separate repository, so the supplementary files fall under the article licence.
implications_for_this_repo: data/raw/ is git-ignored so the files are never redistributed from here.
M3 reports numbers and method only; no model weights and no dataset are published.
Commercial use requires separate permission from the authors.

files.caption: Supplementary Table S1: data for known antibiotics used to validate the screen
Supplementary Table S2: retention data of 421 non-antibiotic drugs
Supplementary Table S3: retention data, SMILES for 6407 compounds, and 36 calculated molecular attributes of 6416 classified compounds used to train the prediction model

strains.source: article body: 'the retention of 13,056 compounds in the TolC mutant E. coli 2350 and the isogenic parent 2122'

published_comparison_value.note: Reported in this paper for this dataset; not independently verified here.

attribution_required: Hoffmann et al. Sci Rep 2025, DOI 10.1038/s41598-025-10208-6, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0
reason: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0: the NonCommercial and NoDerivatives clauses fail the Open Definition. Replaced by the CHAMP dataset (CC BY 4.0), which also separates permeability from efflux across four strains.
note: The xlsx files were deleted; this manifest is kept as the record of the licence check so the investigation is not repeated.
